item.title: Cloudflare Dashboard and Cloudflare API service issues in EU region
item.description: Cloudflare is investigating issues with Cloudflare Dashboard and related APIs in EU region. These issues do not affect the serving of cached files via the Cloudflare CDN or other security features at the Cloudflare Edge. Customers using the Dashboard / Cloudflare APIs are impacted as requests might fail and/or errors may be displayed.

item.title: Cache Purging Delays in Amsterdam
item.description: Cloudflare single-file cache purging (purge by URL) called via the Dashboard/API is delayed in Amsterdam. We are working to resolve this issue as soon as possible. item.title: Hanko before 3.2.0 Account Takeover via SAML Redirect Allowlist Bypass
item.description: Hanko before 3.2.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability in Saml.IsAllowedRedirect that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the redirect allowlist by appending attacker-controlled domain suffixes to allowed hostnames. Attackers can lure victims through a crafted /saml/auth login link to capture the one-time hanko token and redeem it without PKCE to hijack the victim's session.

GNU opens first and compares the opened output inode against the input before truncating.
